arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step,'cancel',ce.event_id,'held',h.booking_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON b.request_id=ce.request_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id=h.booking_id WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step,'cancel',ce.event_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON b.request_id=ce.request_id WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'status',o.status,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'checkin',ci.booking_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON o.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN checkins ci ON o.booking_id=ci.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'audit' AS kind,json_object('pending_bookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),'pending_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),'confirmed_missing_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id)),'confirmed_wrong_charge_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE status='confirmed' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE 'cancelled',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'cancel_event',ce.event_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'refund_amount',r.amount_cents) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON ce.request_id=b.request_id LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.charge_id=c.charge_id WHERE b.status='cancelled'
